notes.title: The Workshop is now Open!
notes.notes:
G'day you Action-hungry folk!

The Steam Workshop is ready and the Mission Editor is up in official manner. We even put one Showcase Level up in the Workshop, so head over there and download it quickly, before supplies run out. (I kid, I kid).

Shortcut this way:
[b]https://steamcommunity.com/app/686200/workshop/[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/29ee82665449e6f7f1d0bfb63850fdf735f65c50.png[/img]

The Workshop supports game levels, which you can subscribe to and will promptly appear in your in-game Workshop menu to enable/disable at will. And then you will find them in the Workshop Chapter at the end of the "Chapter Selection Screen" and you can play them at will. 
The Workshop also supports game changing mods. Head over here for more info on this topic:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1569771035

As for the [b]Level Editor[/b], it's well hidden in your Steam Install folder, specifically in this location:

[i]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Door Kickers Action Squad\tools\ActionSquadEd.exe[/i]

The Editor loads by default a handy "almost empty new level" that should give you a headstart for your designs. The whole tool is a little light on documentation but we'll provide more in the following weeks - though it's not rocket science, in any case. Just study or modify the existing game levels :) 

https://youtu.be/bQRQksOjJtk

Once you're happy with your work, there's a handy "Workshop Mod Uploader" button in its menu, and you can share your creation with the world.

Have fun,  be creative, and expect a "Best Level" Contest soon :)

Your friends @  KHG/Pixelshard

You know the drill - get your pixelated Mp5s and workout those boots  - [b]Action Squad is now out of Early Access![/b]

We’ve had a successful run of 10 months in Steam Early Access and more than 18k of you have already kicked doors with us, and we couldn’t have done it without you. For all you who supported us and put up with our development issues and bugs  - [b]Thank You![/b] 

When launching the new version, the game will ask to reset your profile. [u]Please, please please, listen to that advice and start from scratch again[/u]. The game changed a lot and its worth it to take it slowly again - and it also prevents unforeseen profile corruption and conflicts. 

Hundreds of you have already shown us how much you like the game - through emails, messages, forum posts, reviews or even the good old face to face nod at PAX and Gamescom. 

And there’s nothing quite like the smile and thumbs-up you get from a stranger after playing your game. 

But [b]development doesn’t stop here[/b], so neither should your feedback stop. Tell us what you like. What you don’t. What you want more of. 

And expect more to come. More missions. More game modes. Mission Editor. Workshop Support. More mission types. More playable characters. And, of course, more, more crazyness.

Also released is the stellar soundtrack by Gavin Harrison. If you like your synthwave as much as we do, get the soundtrack too!

Enough talking, get kicking - there's a cartel that needs to be put down. 

Your DevTeams @ KillHouse Games & PixelShard Labs

notes.title: Door Kickers: Action Squad is like a two-player 2D Rainbow Six Siege
notes.notes:
The original Door Kickers was a lovely little tactical puzzle game released in 2014. Door Kickers 2: Task Force North was announced two years later later and said to be coming in 2016, but it's still nowhere to be seen. However, developer KillHouse Games actually has another game out to scratch that door kicking itch. It's Door Kickers: Action Squad, and it's out now on Steam Early Access. 

Where Door Kickers was all about carefully executing SWAT maneuvers and rescuing hostages, Door Kickers: Action Squad is a 2D side-scroller that feels more like Broforce. It's a cartoonishly high-octane game about shooting first, asking questions never, and maybe rescuing some hostages in the process. It could hardly be more different from the original game, but Action Squad is still a heck of a lot of fun. 

I recently had the opportunity to play it for myself, and even in Early Access, Action Squad looks, sounds and feels good, especially in co-op. You play as one of four SWAT operatives decked out in customizable weapons, gear and abilities, from riot shields and bulletproof vests to tear gas grenades and sniper support. Your goal is to clear out all the bad guys in each level and save as many hostages as possible. The better you do, the more stars you earn, which means more upgrades for your favorite equipment. 

As you kill bad guys, you earn energy which can be used to refill your gear, spawn armor or med kits, or activate screen-clearing abilities. The energy system gives levels a good sense of flow—if I take these two guys out first, I'll have enough energy to take out this group of three easily—and it works great in multiplayer because you can strategize around each other's abilities and resources. 

I had fun playing on my own, but Action Squad really benefits from the inclusion of local and online co-op. It's fun to experiment with different combinations of operatives. You can play as Shield and hold the line, for example, while your friend rips through dudes as the Assaulter. It feels a lot like Rainbow Six Siege in these moments, in no small part because, like the original Door Kickers, Action Squad is hard as hell. You can kill most enemies with a few shots, but if you get caught out in the open, you'll torn apart nearly as quickly. 

KillHouse Games reckons Action Squad will stay in Early Access until later this July, with more enemies, bosses, operatives, and levels to be added in the interim. It's currently $12 on Steam, but its price will jump to around $15 when it leaves Early Access.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/d57f418437d7553f3e4e213dcc267d45525ee215.gif[/img]
[b]
- Added Steam Achievements 
- Major Improvements to Breacher class
- Added 3 new breacher shotguns: M870, KSG, HK512, and completely changed buckshot damage patterns
- Added Breacher SAW special ability. It cuts through all doors and enemies alike![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/ed2113c751aecc22774d123d53be628468e15321.png[/img]
- Added Breacher Speed Loader gear - loads 4 shells at once
- Can now call Strategic Abilities when mounted on ladders
- [b]Improved Ammo and Health boxes placement logic[/b]
- Changed grenade throwing mechanics from ladders - use up, down, directions to control throw
- Added a small window of invulnerability after respawning
- 6 new levels, concluding Chapter 3
- Explosive barrels now break doors! Kick that barrel!
- Various fixes and improvements
- 2 new backgrounds

[h1]Update 1 - 26 Feb 2018[/h1]
- [b]Added 2 new ingame tunes[/b]
- reduced game's RAM footprint
- [b]Added some cheats.[/b] Will probably remove them after Early Access.
- Network coop desync fixes (exploding barrels, item prices, etc)
- Breacher slugs can now be shot from mid-air 
- Fixed: Breacher armor disappearing when switching to slugs
- Fixed: Weapons locking when spamming the reload or fire buttons

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/9b053b935d497a8bcbd68b77481274d2fb78f8a5.gif[/img]

notes.title: January patch delayed
notes.notes:
We're sorry to report the delay of the January patch.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/3ccc56056112c6aced08e087fcdce2c8b4703b79.jpg[/img]

There were parts of the code that needed to be rewritten and reorganized to  account for the additions and changes to the breacher code - shotgun functionality, including the often requested slug shot change. 

This has proven trickier than expected but will allow us some cool tricks and also make adding more weapons - by devs or modders - much easier in the future. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/7db1d76614796c237229261e8ae42bc0d18a630a.jpg[/img]

But this also means the changes are too deep to launch a partial update - we discussed getting just the new levels and achievements out for now. Not possible, its all or nothing now.

We're working as fast as possible to get the version ready for release.

Thank you for your patience,

Your devs @ KHG & PixelShard

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/3346323d086ca7e98b7f1e4ffcad5ac3719a006b.gif[/img]

[h1]New Content and Changes in v0.5.19[/h1]

+ [b] 2 new enemies: Molotov Manny and Fanatic Frankie[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/515ca7081146943eee3630851b4d4d40ec1465f6.png[/img]
+ [b] 2 new special abilities: Dragon Breath Rounds and SMG Assault[/b]
+ [b] Leaderboards (single player / coop)[/b]
+ [b] 2 more in-game soundtracks[/b]
+ [b] 6 new missions[/b]
+ [b] Wounded Cop NPC[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/16935bc26e1e801962ac2f8d21a8669aa8d91cb9.png[/img]

+ Changed mission target bomb artwork
+ Added Christmas... Easter egg
+ Updated older levels
+ You can now throw grenades from ladders in all directions [i](keep left/right/down when throwing)[/i]
+ Grenades can be thrown through windows now [i](Breaching Charge still sticks)[/i]
+ Updated weapons on some enemies
+ Updated graphics [i](tileset, explosions, characters)[/i]
+ Enemies that are too close get pushed away
+ Added hostage voices
+ Added crows here and there, and rats, lots of rats
+ Added cool "Spawn" and "Reinforcement Called" animations
+ Removed class selection after dying and respawning

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

+ Fixed: dying when passing through doors resulted in transparent corpse
+ Fixed: changed breaching charge on horizontal glass damage rule
+ Fixed: rare "level finished" message while enemies still coming in through doors
+ Fixed: hostage kill not counted when used as human shield by Leader Lemmy
+ Fixed: minor AI glitches when the enemy lost target
+ Fixed: sometimes enemies could shoot you even if in cover mode
+ Fixed: Sniper Support shooting dead targets (if killed after enemy marked as sniper target)
+ Fixed: Sniper targets weren't counted as kills for the player that activated the Sniper Assist

notes.title: Update v0.5.18
notes.notes:
[h1]Content update is still coming in December![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/4f9e45daff72fecb0ce19f0bd2bc51e1dc2817f3.gif[/img]
[h1]Changes in this version:[/h1]
[b]+ Added CHAT (press ENTER to open chat interface during Online COOP)[/b]
[b]+ Fixed rare network disconnect message when finishing a mission in coop[/b]
+ Added CRC check on important files. When modding the game one can only play with peers having the same mod enabled (Network error was shown before)
+ Added new "ready" sounds for Assaulter in player selection screen
+ Sniper support kills alert nearby enemies
+ Damage over Time frags (eg. fire from flashbangs) give the player Strategic Points now
+ Fixed grenades and barrel napalm lumps falling from hidden rooms when exiting the room too early
+ Fixed small bug that allowed the player to win a level when shooting the last and only hostage
+ When kicking down a door enemies will hear it and get alerted on both sides of the door now
+ Fixed Suicide Bomber damage on players with armor (more deadly)
+ Fixed breaching charge explosion damage and enemy alert events
+ Melee now hits enemies that are really close too
+ Fixes a bug where close enemies wouldn't get pushed back by melee
+ Fixed some errors in some of the levels (errors reported by players)
+ Changed the order of some levels based on their difficulty

notes.title: Update 0.5.17
notes.notes:
Many bug-fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Content update coming in december!


Changelist:
------------------------
+ visual/gameplay improvements on several maps
+ Alt + F1 during gameplay brings up keyboard layout
+ ingame Help mode (F1) shows the Special Ability key when Strategic Bar is full
+ added Exit button on COOP WIN Screen
+ added Next Mission button on COOP LOSE Screen
+ restart now takes you to class selection screen
+ bomber doesn't explode anymore when kicked
+ you can't use special ability in midair or on ladders anymore
+ shows frame latency on multiplayer and FPS when pressing F5
+ barrels incendiated by players that kill enemies count the enemies as kills
+ removed stun from barrel napalm particles
+ strategic bar blinks when getting strategic points
+ respawn buddy icon blinks when playing a 2 player game
+ sniper Support doesn't give SP anymore
+ sniper Support doesn't kill enemies under fog of war
+ you can now jump for a few frames after falling off a platform (you can jump after breaking the horizontal glass too)
+ fixed super powerful air kick effect when kicking an enemy to death near an edge and sending him flying
+ removed aiming error on aimed shot
+ fixed Leader Lemmy "GET HIM" loop
+ COOP: fixed rare lock bug on mission end
+ tuned M4 Carbine a bit different. Its' damage is dependent on range now, to reflect fragmentation

notes.title: Welcome to Early Access - let the bug fixing begin!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, welcome!

First of all, if you're still trying to make up your mind about the game, we found a pretty cool let's play... in coop!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HE8O8iNWnmQ

Secondly, we know many people don't like Early Access (unfinished/buggy games), but it's one of the few options we, as a small developer, have of actually finishing the game and make it better!

We are our own QA team and obviously can't find all the issues. Also, we really appreciate the fresh suggestions/ideas for the next updates! We're 6 dudes locked in a small box (ok, apartment), sometimes we need some out-of-the-box thinking.

We already released two bug-fixing patches, and are working really hard towards the next big update, which will bring tons of new content. TONS! Like a lot. Huuuuge!

Anyway, thanks for the help and let's make this game awesome, because it already is unique, ha!

Like...really, just look:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30444167/eb3e64d469a7d02c7261c75a7231af3cfe7bee9a.png[/img]
See?



OK here's what we fixed until now:

v0.5.16 from 19-Nov-2017
------------------------
+ Fixed bugs that would result in the game freezing while playing online (FINAL)
+ Speed Pouches now give you -30% Reload Time
+ Improved random level selection when quick playing online


v0.5.15 from 19-Nov-2017
------------------------
+ Fixed several bugs that would result in the game freezing while playing online (could still happen, please let us know if it does)
+ Fixed several issues in levels: 1.1, 2.2, 2.5, 2.7
+ Fixed script-related crash
+ Fixed character selection screen desync
+ Fixed screen flashing red when team-mate got hit
+ Added DPI Awareness
